max_size.description: Maximum size of the cache (e.g., 5G, 10G, 0 for unlimited). Accepts k/M/G/T (decimal) and Ki/Mi/Gi/Ti (binary) suffixes.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files in the cache (0 = unlimited).

compression.description: Whether to compress stored data using Zstandard.

compression_level.description: Zstandard compression level (0 = auto-select level 1; positive = faster-to-slower+compress; negative = ultra-fast).

compiler_check.description: Method to identify compiler changes: 'content', 'mtime', 'none', 'string:value', or a command string.

base_dir.description: Base directory for path rewriting (e.g., '/home/user'). Empty string disables rewriting.

hash_dir.description: Whether to include current working directory in hash for debug info builds.

direct_mode.description: Whether to use direct mode (faster than preprocessor mode).

depend_mode.description: Whether to use depend mode (relies on dependency files from compiler).

inode_cache.description: Whether to cache source file inode hashes.

hard_link.description: Whether to use hard links instead of copying files.

sloppiness.description: List of sloppiness settings (relaxations for caching). Allowed items: clang_index_store, file_stat_matches, file_stat_matches_ctime, gcno_cwd, incbin, include_file_ctime, include_file_mtime, ivfsoverlay, locale, modules, pch_defines, random_seed, system_headers, time_macros.

disable.description: Whether to disable ccache completely (bypass cache).

temporary_dir.description: Path to temporary directory. Empty string uses default auto-detected path.

namespace.description: Optional namespace string for separating cache entries (e.g., per-project).

ignore_options.description: List of compiler options to ignore in hashing. Supports wildcards (*).

extra_files_to_hash.description: List of extra files to include in the hash (colon-separated on Unix, semicolon on Windows).

debug_dir.description: Path to directory for debug files when debug mode is enabled.

debug_level.description: Debug level (1 = log only, 2 = full debug output).

debug.description: Whether to enable debug mode (creates per-object debug files).

stats_log.description: Path to stats log file for per-build statistics.

remote_storage.description: List of remote storage backend URLs (space-separated, but provided as a list). Format: 'file:/path' | 'http://host' | 'redis://host:port'.

remote_only.description: Whether to use remote storage only (skip local cache).

reshare.description: Whether to reshare cache hits to remote storage.
